page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c2g1.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated physical CPU cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, providing dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading. The system is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, translating to 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type includes a single NVIDIA Tesla P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 1 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5i-c2g1.large offers entry-level GPU acceleration. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing, but the lack of local storage and the modest 1 Gbps network baseline present potential bottlenecks for data-intensive operations. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio provides a balanced environment for workloads requiring modest memory alongside GPU capabilities.

This hardware configuration is designed for workloads such as entry-level deep learning inference, video transcoding, and lightweight graphics rendering. The combination of a dedicated dual-core CPU and a single P4 GPU makes it suitable for small-scale AI model deployment and parallel processing tasks that do not require high-throughput local disk I/O.
